stem: Vanadium, niobium and tantalum are metals in the same group of the Periodic Table.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.stem: The shorthand electronic configuration of vanadium in the ground state is $\text{[Ar]}3\text{d}^34\text{s}^2$.
parts.text: State what is meant by the term ground state.

parts.text:
Show the electronic configuration of vanadium using electrons in boxes notation.

parts.label: (a)(iii)
parts.text: Deduce the total number of electrons in the p sub-shells of a vanadium atom.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem:
Pelopium was the suggested name for a new element discovered in a mineral.

Pelopium was later found to be a mixture of niobium, Nb, and tantalum, Ta.

Only one naturally occurring isotope exists for each of Nb and Ta.
parts.text:
Complete Table 1.1.

Table 1.1

| isotope | relative isotopic mass | number of protons | number of neutrons |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| $^{93}_{41}\text{Nb}$ | 92.91 |  |  |
| $^{181}_{73}\text{Ta}$ | 180.95 |  |  |

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text:
A sample of pelopium contains 90.9% by mass $^{93}_{41}\text{Nb}$ and 9.1% by mass $^{181}_{73}\text{Ta}$.

Calculate the theoretical relative atomic mass of pelopium based on these data and Table 1.1.

Give your answer to two decimal places.

Show your working.
